chunks: And fear Him who created you and all the earlier people.
ai.seo_question: Who is described as the Creator of you and the earlier people in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a rhetorical counterpoint to the poets' claims of divine inspiration, asserting that true authority belongs to the Creator of all generations. Shia exegesis highlights the 'first generations' (al-jibilla al-awwalin) as a testament to the continuity of prophetic guidance and the enduring nature of Tawhid across history. It underscores that God's power over creation is absolute, rendering human poetic or prophetic claims subordinate to His singular will.
